summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses the origin and history of the word kuracha, an old Spanish term for a small pouch used to hold a talit and tipline. He explains how the style of these pouches has changed over the generations, moving from plain blue velvet bags in the United States to personalized needlepoint creations made by family members.
questions: What does the word kuracha mean?
Where did the word kuracha originate?
How have the bags used for a talit and tipline changed over time?
Who makes the custom kurachas used in the community today?
